effects: Sends the signer's entire staked LP-token balance (0x1FBC…1902, read from storage) from the contract back to the signer, and sets the signer's stake to zero.
Sends all of the signer's accrued rewards in the reward token (0x97B3…8943, amount read from storage) to the signer.
Reverts if the signer has nothing staked (withdraw(0) raises ZeroAmount).
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw all and claim" with no fields: it names neither the LP token being withdrawn nor the reward token being claimed.

findings.title: exit(): the screen names neither the LP token withdrawn nor the reward token claimed.
findings.evidence: StakingRewards.sol exit(): withdraw(_balances[msg.sender]); getReward(); — stakingToken 0x1FBC…1902 and rewardsToken 0x97B3…8943 (meta.json constructorArguments). descriptor exit(): intent "Withdraw and claim", interpolatedIntent "Withdraw all and claim", fields []. Case 1 screen shows no fields.
findings.fix: Use interpolatedIntent "Withdraw all staked LP tokens and claim rewards", and add literal-value fields (spec §value) that name the staked token 0x1FBC…1902 and the reward token 0x97B3…8943 with addressName/token formatting.

findings.title: exit(): the amounts withdrawn and claimed come from storage and cannot appear on the screen.
findings.evidence: StakingRewards.sol exit() uses _balances[msg.sender]; getReward() pays rewards[msg.sender]. Neither value is in the calldata (0xe9fad8ee).
findings.fix: None possible in calldata. The word "all" already conveys the full stake.

cases.notes: Synthetic, not mined. Judged from the code: both effects are stated only generically ("withdraw all", "claim"), with no asset named and amounts from storage. The reader list is empty because there is no mined tx.

effects: Sends the signer's accrued rewards in the reward token 0x97B3…8943 to the signer, in an amount read from storage (rewards[msg.sender] after updateReward), and resets the accrued amount to zero.
formats.shown: Intent "Claim staking rewards" with no fields: the reward token and the amount are not named.

findings.title: getReward(): the screen does not name the reward token that the signer receives.
findings.evidence: StakingRewards.sol getReward(): rewardsToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, reward); rewardsToken is immutable 0x97B3…8943 (meta.json). descriptor getReward(): fields [], interpolatedIntent "Claim staking rewards".
findings.fix: Add a literal-value field labelled 'Reward token' with value 0x97B3070F9Da6C002343862b35E68Bd8e22608943 (addressName with types ["token"]), or name the token in the intent.

findings.title: getReward(): the claimed amount is read from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: StakingRewards.sol getReward(): uint256 reward = rewards[msg.sender]; calldata is just 0x3d18b912.

effects: Moves `amount` of the LP token 0x1FBC…1902 from the signer to the staking contract, using the signer's allowance.
Increases the signer's staked balance by `amount`, which starts earning reward tokens; rewards accrued so far are checkpointed but not paid.
formats.shown: "Stake {amount}" with an Amount field formatted as tokenAmount of 0x1FBC…1902 (UNI-V2), which matches the contract's stakingToken.

cases.notes: Synthetic, not mined. The token constant matches the immutable stakingToken on chain 10143. Screen: 'Stake 1 UNI-V2'.

effects: Sends `amount` of the LP token 0x1FBC…1902 from the staking contract to the signer.
Reduces the signer's staked balance by `amount`; accrued rewards are checkpointed and stay claimable, not paid.
formats.shown: "Withdraw {amount}" with an Amount field formatted as tokenAmount of 0x1FBC…1902 (UNI-V2), and the intent "Withdraw LP tokens".
